value.rationale: The unique cubic girth-eight cage is a natural benchmark in the original high-girth exponential-domination program. The sharp weighted optimum 4 (versus known ordinary domination 9), canonical 45-flag complete optimizer classification, and sharp three-at-a-time replacement barrier with diameter-two connectedness identify nontrivial global mobility of a natural optimum family. These are not an arbitrary extra digit or routine restatement of existing bounds.
